Although the puzzle group students had less time to work together, eight weeks later the difference between the two groups had become apparent. Through objective observation, pupils in puzzle classes are less biased and negative stereotypes than those in traditional classes and become more confident and fond of classes. In addition, fewer children in puzzle classes are absent and more advanced than in traditional classes; The scores of students with poor grades are also clearly higher than those of the traditional classes, with minor differences in the achievement of the first class (Aronson, 1978).

p150.original: 推动立法 道德无法被制定成法律，对吗？一项最有说服力的研究证明了这句话是错误的，20世纪40年代的一项实验比较了公共住房项目中白人租户对黑人租户的态度。
p150.en: It's not possible to make a law about morality, is it? One of the most convincing studies proved that this was wrong, and an experiment in the 1940s compared the attitude of white tenants to black tenants in public housing projects.

p151.original: 1. 在第一个项目中，将白人和黑人居住者分配到不同的建筑物中，也就是实施了种族隔离。
p151.en: 1. In the first project, white and black residents were assigned to different buildings, i.e. apartheid.

p152.original: 2. 第二个项目则把白人和黑人分配到同一栋建筑物中，从而使两个种族群体混住。
p152.en: 2. The second project allocated whites and blacks to the same building, thus mixing the two ethnic groups.

p153.original: 后者的偏见态度显著下降（Deutsch & Collins，1951）。这一结果表明，强制性平等交往的规则可以减少偏见。
p153.en: The latter's biased attitude has decreased significantly (Deutsch & Collins, 1951). This result shows that the rules of compulsory and equal communication can reduce prejudice.

p154.original: 一个规模更大、控制条件更为宽松的社会“实验”证实了这个概念。在过去的60年里，美国废除种族歧视的法律使偏见和歧视已逐渐减少，即使有时会引发暴力和伤害。来自20世纪40年代最初的民意调查提供了偏见态度转变的证据。那时支持废除种族隔离的白人不到30%，现在这一比例已经稳步增长至90%以上（Aronson，2004）。同样，现代美国各州关于婚姻平等的司法裁决也迅速地改变了人们对长期以来一直是被歧视对象的少数群体的态度。此外，美国各市、州和联邦当局承认警察在种族定性方面的歧视性做法有时会使黑人丧命。这迫使美国警察在雇佣、培训和纪律方面进行制度改革。美国司法部长埃里克·霍尔德（Eric Holder）最近报告了在密苏里州弗格森市（Ferguson，Missouri），一名黑人青年被几名白人警察枪杀的暴力事件。霍尔德说，这种情况很普遍，甚至在很多地方部门也很常见。
p154.en: This concept is confirmed by the social “experiment” of a larger society with more relaxed control conditions. Over the past 60 years, the abolition of racial discrimination laws in the United States had led to a gradual reduction in prejudice and discrimination, even if they sometimes led to violence and harm. A poll from the early 1940s provided evidence of a shift in biased attitudes. Less than 30 per cent of whites who supported the abolition of apartheid at that time have now steadily increased to more than 90 per cent (Aronson, 2004). Similarly, modern American state judicial decisions on equality in marriage have rapidly changed attitudes towards minority groups that have long been the object of discrimination. In addition, United States municipalities, states and federal authorities have acknowledged that discriminatory police practices in racial profiling can sometimes kill blacks. This has forced the United States police to undertake institutional reforms in hiring, training and discipline. Eric Holder, United States Attorney General, recently reported violent incidents in Ferguson, Missouri, Missouri, in which a young black man was shot dead by several white policemen. According to Holder, this situation is widespread, even in many local sectors.

p155.original: 2014年8月9日，在密苏里州弗格森市，一名手无寸铁的非洲裔青年被警察开枪打死，引发了当地民众的普遍不满和暴力抗议。
p155.en: On 9 August 2014, in Ferguson, Missouri region, an unarmed young African citizen was shot and killed by police, triggering widespread discontent and violent protests by the local population.

p156.original: 由于不能控制公众舆论，我们便不能断言是立法减少了人们的偏见。但认知失调理论可以帮助我们预测将会有越来越多的美国人支持废除种族隔离和婚姻平等。当法律要求人们以非歧视性的方式行事时，人们就必须通过减少他们的偏见态度来减少认知失调。从这个角度来看，似乎一旦立法并实施确实会影响人们的偏见态度。美国最高法院于2015年7月做出了一项裁决，确认了任何美国公民都拥有与自己选择的伴侣结婚的宪法权利，尽管仍存在个人抵制，但整个美国对这一争议性问题的态度无疑会发生改变。
p156.en: Without control of public opinion, we cannot assert that legislation reduces prejudice. But cognitive disorders can help us predict that more and more Americans will support the abolition of apartheid and marital equality. When the law requires people to act in a non-discriminatory manner, people must reduce cognitive disorders by reducing their biased attitudes. From this perspective, it appears that once legislation is enacted and implemented, it does influence the biased attitudes of the population. The United States Supreme Court issued a ruling in July 2015, affirming the constitutional right of any United States citizen to marry a partner of his or her choice, and despite personal resistance, the attitude of the United States as a whole to this controversial issue will undoubtedly change.

p158.original: 偏见还有另一个看不见的影响。如果我们相信自己是偏见的对象，往往会产生自己在某些方面“不太重要”的感受，进而影响我们在各种能力测试中的表现。这一原则是由研究人员克劳德·斯蒂尔、他的同事和学生（Steele et al.，2002）在社会心理学这一新领域开展的大量研究中发现的。刻板印象威胁（stereotype threat）是指当一个人意识到他或她的团队成员在该领域的表现很差时，对他或她的表现产生的负面影响。这项研究表明，个体所属群体的现有刻板印象会影响他们在智力和运动任务中的表现。即使个人不相信刻板印象，它也会发生；重要的是其他人所持有的和当事人意识到的刻板印象，会威胁到自我认同（Haslam et al.，2008）。
p158.en: Prejudice has another invisible effect. If we believe that we are the object of prejudice, we often feel that we are “less important” in some respects, which in turn affects our performance in various competency tests. This principle was discovered by the researcher Claude Steele, his colleagues and students (Steele et al., 2002) in a number of studies carried out in the new field of social psychology. Stereotype threat is the negative impact on a person's performance when he or she is aware that his or her team members are performing poorly in this area. This study shows that the existing stereotypes of the groups to which individuals belong influence their performance in intellectual and sporting tasks. Even if a person does not believe in stereotypes, it happens; What is important is that the stereotypes held by others and of the parties themselves threaten self-identification (Haslam et al., 2008).

p159.original: 在一项研究中，女大学生参加了一项特殊的数学测试，最初她们的成绩和男生一样，而当她们需要在方框里打钩来提醒自己是女生后，她们的成绩明显变差了，由此证实了人们对女性和数学的刻板印象。同样，黑人的智商比白人低的刻板印象会在无意识中造成黑人的焦虑，他们担心自证了这种刻板印象，从而干扰了他们的最佳认知加工和积极自我认同，最终他们也确实表现得更差。从空间推理到打高尔夫球的各种任务中，当对某些领域的缺陷存在消极刻板印象时，突出某人的自我认同会导致其表现下滑（McGlone & Aronson，2006；Stone et al.，1999）。幸运的是，新的研究发现，这种影响是可以逆转的。如果你想知道答案，请继续读下去!
p159.en: In one study, female university students took a special mathematics test, initially their grades were the same as those of boys, and when they had to hook in boxes to remind themselves that they were girls, their performance had changed markedly, confirming the stereotyped image of women and mathematics. Similarly, black stereotypes lower than whites cause black anxiety unconsciously, fearing that self-censorship may interfere with their optimal cognitive processing and positive self-identification, and eventually they do behave worse. In missions ranging from spatial reasoning to golfing, highlighting a person's self-identification can lead to a decline in performance when there is a negative stereotyping of deficiencies in certain areas (McGlone & Aaronson, 2006); Stone et al., 1999. Fortunately, new studies have found that the impact is reversible. If you want answers, keep reading!

p160.original: 11.9.4 内隐的种族偏见会影响刑事判决
p160.en: 11.9.4 Invisible racial prejudice affects criminal sentencing

p161.original: 斯坦福大学教授詹妮弗·埃伯哈特（Jennifer Eberhardt）最近因其开创性的研究获得了麦克阿瑟奖（天才奖），该研究揭示了在对黑人的死刑判决的判决程度以及其他针对他们的消极行为中，人们的隐性偏见是如何产生消极影响的（Eberhardt & Hetey，2014；Eberhardt & Rattan，2010）。
p161.en: Jennifer Eberhardt, a professor at Stanford University, recently received the MacArthur Award for his groundbreaking research, which reveals how hidden prejudices have had a negative impact on the degree of sentencing of blacks to death and on other negative behaviour against them (Eberhardt & Hetey, 2014); Eberhardt & Rattan, 2010.

p162.original: 在一项研究中，实验者首先收集了已判定犯有严重罪行并等待判决的人的照片。在所有案件中，陪审团都可以选择判处罪犯死刑。然后，这些罪犯的照片被裁剪，使其没有明显的刑事定罪迹象，斯坦福大学的学生（也就是实验的被试）会被问及每一张脸看起来有多像“典型的黑人”。研究中并没有特别说明什么是“典型的黑人”，相反，实验者会告知被试他们可以根据任何对自己有意义的特征来做出判断。这项研究有两个重要发现。
p162.en: In one study, the experimenter first collected photographs of persons convicted of serious crimes and awaiting judgement. In all cases, the jury has the option of imposing the death penalty on the offender. The photographs of the criminals were then trimmed, leaving no clear signs of criminalization, and students at Stanford University (i.e. the experiment was tested) were asked how much each face looked like “typical blacks”. The study did not specifically describe what was meant by “typical blacks”, but rather the experimenters would tell them that they could judge by any characteristics that made sense to them. The study has two important findings.

p163.original: 第一，埃伯哈特的团队注意到，在“典型黑人”这一概念上被试达成了令人惊讶的共识。尽管被试都是在没有实验者的引导下做出自己的判断的，但对于哪些面孔更具“典型黑人”的特征，被试之间存在广泛的共识。
p163.en: First, the team in Eberhart noted that there had been a surprising consensus on the concept of “typical black”. Although the trials were conducted without the guidance of the experimenters to make their own judgments, there was a broad consensus on which faces were more “typical black”.

p164.original: 第二，当最终宣判被定罪的人时，那些在实验中被认为面部更具“典型黑人”特征的罪犯被判死刑的可能性是那些面部特征没那么典型的罪犯的两倍多。
p164.en: Secondly, when convicted persons are finally convicted, those convicted of crimes considered to be more face-to-face “typical black” features in the experiment are more than twice as likely to be sentenced to death as those with less typical facial characteristics.

p165.original: 在其他的研究中，埃伯哈特将内隐种族偏见与认为黑人携带危险武器的倾向联系起来，并得出了同样令人不安的结果。为了识别无意识偏见，她让被试在电脑屏幕前看一些快速闪过的人脸图像，被试无法有意识地察觉到所看到的东西。在每一系列图像之后，被试会在屏幕上看到一个模糊的物体：在某些情况下，它是一把枪、刀或其他武器，而在其他情况下则不是武器（如订书机）。他们的任务是确定该物体是否构成威胁。当这些面孔都是黑人时，被试能很快正确地识别出武器。当面孔是白人时，被试需要更多的图像才能确定物体是否是武器。埃伯哈特认为，看到黑人面孔会让人产生一种无意识的“准备”，将不明物体视为武器。
p165.en: In other studies, Eberhart has linked hidden racial prejudices to the tendency of blacks to carry dangerous weapons, with equally disturbing results. In order to identify unconscious prejudice, she made it possible to see some quick flashing images of the human face in front of the computer screen and to be unwittingly aware of what was seen. After each series of images, it is tried to see a vague object on the screen: in some cases it is a gun, knife or other weapon, while in others it is not a weapon (e.g. a stapler). Their task is to determine whether the object poses a threat. When these faces are black, they are quickly and correctly identified. When the face is white, more images are needed to determine whether the object is a weapon. Eberhardt believes that seeing a black face creates an unconscious “preparation” to view unknown objects as weapons.

p166.original: 埃伯哈特将她的研究成果运用到社会实践中，她与执法机构合作，并对其成员进行教育，让他们了解到自己的种族偏见，可能会导致他们在应该采取更克制的措施时，却射杀无辜的少数族裔嫌疑人。通过向警察解释这些研究，以及隐性偏见与传统种族主义之间的不同，将帮助他们更清楚地意识到种族是如何无意识地影响我们的判断的。埃伯哈特说：“我不认为单凭这一点就能改变行为，”然而，“如果你把这些和其他东西结合起来，还是有希望的。”（New York Times Scierlce，January5，2015）
p166.en: Eberhart applied her research findings to social practice, working with law enforcement agencies and educating their members about their racial bias, which could lead them to shoot innocent minority suspects when they should take more restraint measures. By explaining these studies to the police, and the difference between hidden prejudices and traditional racism, they will be helped to understand more clearly how race has unwittingly influenced our judgement. Eberhardt said, “I don't think this alone can change behaviour,” but, “If you combine these and other things, there is hope. I'm not sure what I'm talking about, but I'm not sure what I'm doing.

p167.original: 心理学很有用 刻板印象提升和价值观肯定

p168.original: 刻板印象威胁的另一端是刻板印象提升（stereotype lift）：当人们被贴上正面的刻板印象标签时，他们也会表现得更好。如果白人知道自己在参加一个评估智力的测试，或者一个突出黑人的消极刻板印象的测试，这种刻板印象会使他们获得心理优势，进而有更好的表现（Walton & Cohen，2003）。
p168.en: The other end of the threat of stereotypes is stéotype loft: when people are labeled positively, they do better. If white people know they are taking a test to assess their intelligence, or a test to highlight the negative stereotypes of blacks, such stereotypes give them psychological advantages and, in turn, better performance (Walton & Cohen, 2003).

p169.original: 因此，如果亚洲女性在参加数学考试时，强调她们是女性，她们的表现可能会变差，而当提醒她们是亚洲人及亚洲人在数学方面具有优越性时，她们会表现得更好。刻板印象提升再次发挥了作用。因此，刻板印象有利有弊（Shih et al.，1999）。
p169.en: Therefore, Asian women may be worse off if they are stressed in their mathematics exams, and they will be better at reminding them that they are Asians and Asians are superior to mathematics. Sculptural rises have again worked. Thus, stereotypes are both positive and negative (Shih et al., 1999).

p170.original: 我们可以用刻板印象提升来抵消刻板印象威胁吗？也许在应对具有挑战性的考试或课程之前我们可以鼓励人们重新认识最好的自己。在个体学习所属的群体成员通常表现不佳的课程之前，让他们对自己最重要的价值观给予肯定会怎么样呢？更具体地说，如果让女性在开始学习物理入门课程之前肯定自己的价值观，会发生什么？在物理入门课程中，女生的平均成绩通常是C，而男生是B。三宅明及其研究团队（Akira Miyake et al.，2010）开展了这样的研究，证实了大学生的理科成绩的性别差距可以通过简单地肯定价值观的心理干预显著缩小。
p170.en: Can we counter the threat of stereotypes by promoting them? Perhaps before dealing with challenging examinations or courses, we can encourage people to get to know themselves better. What is the degree to which members of the group of which they belong are given their most important values before they learn to study their subjects, which are often underperforming? More specifically, what happens if women are allowed to affirm their values before they begin to study the introduction to physics? In the introduction course, the average achievement of girls is usually C, while that of boys is B. The study conducted by the Three Houses and their research team (Akira Miyake et al., 2010) confirmed that the gender gap in the scientific achievement of university students can be significantly reduced through psychological interventions that simply affirm values.

p171.original: 有500多名学生参加了这个双盲实验，其中一半的男生和女生被随机分配到一个写作练习中，研究者要求他们在学习物理学入门课程之前写下自己最重要的价值观。指导语是：“想一想对你重要的事情。可能是创造力、家庭关系、事业或幽默感。选择其中的两三个价值观，并写几句话说明它们为什么对你很重要。你有15分钟的时间。”在控制组中，要求学生思考对他们来说最不重要的价值观，以及这些价值观与他人有怎样的联系。然后，在学生们完成课程后，研究人员会测试他们的基础物理知识并进行比较。我们从图11-12的数据中可以看出，在对照组中，男生的表现平均比女生高出10个点，这符合男性在物理上比女性更好的刻板印象。然而，在实验组中，这种性别差异几乎消失。自我肯定的女性比未进行自我肯定的女性在测试中取得的成绩更好，对物理概念的理解也更好。因此，即使是一个简单的心理干预也会对女性在物理学科的学习成绩产生很大的影响。
p171.en: More than 500 students participated in this double-blind experiment, half of them boys and girls were randomly assigned to a writing exercise, and researchers asked them to write their most important values before they took the introductory course in physics. The instruction is, "Think about something important to you. It may be creativity, family relations, career or sense of humor. Select two or three of those values and write a few words to explain why they are important to you. You have 15 minutes. In the control group, students are asked to reflect on the values that are least important to them and how they relate to others. After completing the course, researchers will then test and compare their basic physical knowledge. As can be seen from figures 11-12, on average, men perform 10 points higher than women in the control group, which is consistent with the fact that men are more physically stereotyped than women. However, in the experiment groups, this gender gap has almost disappeared. Self-proclaimed women achieve better results in testing than women who fail to do so, and better understand the concept of physics. Thus, even a simple psychological intervention can have a significant impact on women's academic performance in physics.

p172.original: 图11-12 价值观肯定使物理成绩和概念知识的性别差异减小了
p172.en: Figures 11-12 Values certainly reduce gender differences in physical achievement and conceptual knowledge

p173.original: 杰弗里·科恩和他的同事们（Geoffrey Cohen et al.，2006）在对初一年级的白人和黑人学生的研究中也表明肯定价值观的作用。完成这项练习的黑人学生的成绩显著提高。而且，那些成绩最差的人提高得更多。更好的消息是：几次简单的增强训练可以让这些进步持续数年，只需要训练孩子们写下不同的价值观或更深入地研究自己曾写下的价值观（Cohen et al.，2009）。
p173.en: Jeffrey Cohen and his colleagues (Geffery Cohen et al., 2006) also demonstrated the role of value affirmation in their research of white and black students in the first grade. The performance of black students who completed this exercise improved significantly. Moreover, those with the worst grades have increased even more. The better news is that a few simple enhancements of training can allow these advances to continue for several years, just to train children to write different values or to study more deeply the values they have written (Cohen et al., 2009).

p174.original: 心理学很有用 社会痛苦与身体痛苦像吗
p174.en: Is it like social pain or physical suffering?

p175.original: 在这一节中，我们阅读了他人的关系会影响我们对他人的喜恶，甚至造成偏见和歧视。许多这样的情况都涉及社会痛苦。但你有没有想过社会痛苦是否和身体痛苦有关？
p175.en: In this section, we have read that relationships with others affect our feelings for others and even create prejudice and discrimination. Many of these situations involve social suffering. But have you thought about whether social suffering is related to physical suffering?

p176.original: 当我们摔倒、被划伤、被蚊子叮咬或遭受牙痛和头痛困扰时，我们都会受伤。身体上的疼痛是一种不愉快的感觉，但是疼痛信号对我们至关重要，它能让我们注意体内平衡被破坏，需要我们及时采取行动来处理疼痛的症状和根源。
p176.en: When we fall, get scratched, get bit by mosquitoes or get toothaches and headaches, we all get hurt. Physical pain is an unpleasant feeling, but pain signals are vital for us to be aware that the internal balance is being broken and that timely action is required to address the symptoms and causes of pain.

p177.original: 但是，当我们没有被纳入我们想要加入的团队或群体时，其他类型的痛苦又该怎么办呢？
p177.en: But what about other types of suffering when we are not included in the teams or groups we want to join?

p178.original: 如果朋友甩了你该怎么办？
p178.en: What if your friend dumps you?

p179.original: 你对这种因为一些微妙的偏见而被公然拒绝的情况有何感想？
p179.en: How do you feel about this situation, which has been openly rejected because of subtle prejudices?

p180.original: 许多社会痛苦存储在我们过去被拒绝、被辱骂和充满遗憾的记忆库中。
p180.en: Many of the social sufferings are stored in our memory of past rejection, abuse and regret.

p181.original: 作为社会物种，我们需要与他人亲近——我们需要安慰、关心、保护和爱。社会隔离是一种基本的生存威胁，可能会给人们带来心理上的痛苦。加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校社会和情感神经科学实验室的社会心理学家内奥米·艾森伯格（Naomi Eisenberger）最近研究了这两种非常不同的疼痛来源——身体痛苦和社会痛苦，并发现了一些令人惊人的相似之处。
p181.en: As a species of society, we need to be close to others — we need comfort, care, protection and love. Social isolation is a fundamental threat to survival and can cause psychological suffering. Naomi Eisenberger, a social psychologist at the Social and Emotional Neurology Laboratory at the University of California in Los Angeles, recently studied these two very different sources of pain — physical and social suffering — and found some striking similarities.

p182.original: 艾森伯格是如何研究社会痛苦的本质及其与身体痛苦的联系的？她和她的研究团队探讨了被试在经历不同场景时在功能磁共振成像扫描仪中的大脑反应。首先，真被试和另外两个假被试玩一个虚拟的扔球游戏，在某一时刻假被试停止向真被试扔球，只和另一个假被试互相扔球。与陌生人一起玩这个简单的游戏时，被排除在外的感觉激活的脑区与我们经历身体痛苦时激活的脑区相同。此外，他们发现那些对身体痛苦更敏感的人，在掷球游戏中也更容易体验到被拒绝的感受（N.Eisenberger，2013b）。基因证据也表明，携带更为罕见的μ阿片受体基因的人，对身体痛苦更敏感，与社会排斥引发的痛苦相关的神经活动也更强烈，这种基因与对身体痛苦的高敏感性有关（阿片类药物是有效的止痛药）。因此，服用减轻身体痛苦的止痛药也能减少社会排斥的负面反应。通过比较2周内服用对乙酰氨基酚药物的患者和服用安慰剂的患者发现，这种身体止痛药确实减少了人们对社会排斥感的消极反应。
p182.en: How did Eisenberg study the nature of social suffering and its connection to physical suffering? She and her research team discussed brain reactions in the MRI scanners that were tested in different scenarios. First, it was tried and two other fakes were tried on a virtual ball-throwing game, and at one point it was stopped on a fake basis, and it was on the other hand. When playing this simple game with strangers, the sense of exclusion activates the same brain zone as we do when we experience physical pain. In addition, they find it easier to feel rejected in a ball game for those who are more sensitive to physical pain (N. Eisenberger, 2013b). Genetic evidence also shows that people carrying more rare miopolytically receptor genes are more sensitive to physical pain and have stronger neuroactivity associated with the pain caused by social exclusion, which is associated with high sensitivity to physical pain (opioid drugs are effective painkillers). Thus, the use of painkillers to alleviate physical suffering can also reduce the negative effects of social exclusion. By comparing patients who took acetaminophenol drugs with those who took place in two weeks, and those who took the placebo, the body painkillers did reduce negative reactions to social exclusion.

p183.original: 艾森伯格的团队还了解到，身体上的温暖可以与情感上的温暖相媲美（Eisenberger，2012）。首先，他们比较了手持暖手包和手持常温手包的人的神经反应。然后在被试阅读来自朋友和家人充满温柔、爱意的电子邮件时扫描其大脑。结果发现，与奖励相关的脑区神经活动在处理身体温暖和处理来自这些充满爱的信息的社会温暖是一样的!图11-13显示了身体痛苦和社会痛苦在大脑激活方面的显著相似性。
p183.en: Eisenberg's team also learned that the warmth of body is comparable to the warmth of emotion (Eisenberger, 2012). First, they compare the neuro-responses of people with warm handbags and warm handbags. And then they scan their brains when they're being tried on e-mails from friends and family that are filled with tender, loving emails. It turns out that the brain neuroactivity associated with awards is the same as the handling of body warmth and the handling of social warmth from these loving messages! Figures 11-13 show the marked similarities between physical and social pain in brain activation.

p184.original: 因此，获得社会支持和体验到身体温暖的感觉一样好。令人惊讶的是，在最后一组研究中，艾森伯格想知道给予社会支持的人是否会获得类似的神经益处（Eisenberger，2013a）。在最近的一次采访中，艾森伯格描述了她是如何研究这种亲社会行为的。
p184.en: Therefore, it is as good to have social support as to feel the warmth of the body. Surprisingly, in the last set of studies, Eisenberg wondered whether people who gave social support would benefit from similar neuro-benefits (Eisenberger, 2013a). In a recent interview, Eisenberg described how she studied this pro-social behaviour.

p185.original: 我们对这种特殊状态的神经基础很感兴趣。所以我们进行了一项研究，我们选择异性恋夫妇为被试，让夫妇中的女性成员坐在旁边，当她为伴侣提供支持时，我们扫描了她的大脑。她的伴侣就站在功能磁共振成像扫描仪外面，在某些试次中，他受到了电击。在经历电击时，女性可以在某些试次中通过握住他的手臂来为他提供支持。这是一种帮助他人走出消极或痛苦的支持形式。与抚摸没有感到疼痛的伴侣相比，当女性抚摸感到疼痛的伴侣时（即给予支持），我们实际上看到了更多与奖励相关的神经活动。当你的伴侣没有经历任何负面情绪时，提供支持比和其进行身体接触似乎更有意义。
p185.en: We are interested in the neural basis of this particular state. So we did a study, where we chose heterosexual couples to be tested, where the female members of the couple sat next to each other, and when she supported her partner, we scanned her brain. Her partner was standing outside the MRI scanner and in some cases he was subjected to electric shocks. In case of electric shocks, a woman can support him in some cases by holding his arm. It is a form of support that helps others to emerge from negative or painful situations. When a woman caresssssssssssing a partner in pain (i.e. support), we actually see more neuroactivity associated with reward. When your partner does not experience any negative emotions, it seems more meaningful to provide support than to engage with him physically.

p186.en: Figure 11-13: Social and physical suffering of the brain

p187.original: 注：在大脑中，社会和身体温暖激活了相同的奖励中心。
p187.en: Note: In the brain, the same incentive centres are activated by social and physical warmth.
